newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.
newsitem.headline: Swiss set terms on three-month money market claims.

text.p: The Swiss federal government set terms on three-month money market claims to be paid for on February 20, the Swiss National Bank said.
The new series 3.374 allocated 1.063 billion francs at the price of 99.622, paying a rate of 1.501 on an annual basis. Bids totaled 1.368 billion francs.
The previous issue of three-month claims series 3.373 paid for on February 13 raised 869.6 million francs and was priced at 99.627 to yield 1.481 percent annually.
